item.title: America at a crossroads. What if MAGA Trump bloodlust sets the stage for greater ‘state terror’ atrocities?
item.description: Losing the House (and Senate) will induce a 2020 replay but this time desperate Chicken Little will implode when repeating the same pathetic, “rigged” trickery again.

item.title: Breaking things: A proposal of resistance
item.description: A proposal of resistance seeking people to think about what can be done, and what is required from local governments to response to the viciousness and brutality of ICE and other federal agents occupying our cities and towns.

item.title: Senator Cory Booker is wrong—ICE doesn’t need ‘better training,’ ICE needs to be abolished
item.description: That being said, it’s the wholesale cowardice of the democratic party that is the cause of this disease—fascism.

item.title: The United States of consumption
item.description: Our trash and our lives, here and abroad.
